title: BELLA 9-Piece StoreMore Cookware Set — Black

comparisons.notes: Black nine-piece set, available from CTS Warehouse on Walmart Marketplace. Free delivery when checked.

writeup: This nesting cookware set is a practical fit for a kitchen with limited cupboard space. Woot’s $29.99 price is 49% below the matching black set offered on Walmart Marketplace at $59. The nine-piece count includes lids and protective accessories, so compare the actual vessels you need rather than treating it as nine pans.
notes: Includes four cooking vessels, two lids and three protectors. Woot lists a 90-day warranty. Check the stated temperature limits before oven use.
